result.evidence: The hypothesis describes how directional microstructures (riblets on shark skin denticles) reduce drag through micro-streams that reduce viscous dissipation. This is directly supported by the source document which explains that riblets interact with near-wall turbulent structures, lift vortices away from the surface, and reduce the shear stress transfer to the surface. The mechanism described in the hypothesis is a restatement of the hydrodynamic function explained in the source document.
